Violet, six-armed serpent of Limbo, crowned by a halo of shifting Primordial runes. Strive to become Herald of the Maelstrom, grand priest.

AC 15, HP 58, ATK 2 bite +12 (3d8) or great warpwave or warp reality, MV near (fly, swim), S +4, D +5, C +4, I +3, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 12

Being of Chaos. Only damaged by silver or magical sources. Immune to acid.

Blessing of Chaos. 1/day, can reroll one roll.

Great Warpwave. All beings within near of protean (including protean), CHA 15+ with DISADV or take 1d8 attribute damage. d6: 1. STR, 2. DEX, 3. CON, 4. INT, 5. WIS, 6. CHA.

Warp Reality. Transform a section of terrain up to 30 feet in width and depth within double near at will, turning mud to rock, earth to air, water to wine, etc.
